content_fields.title: Ensure pipeline definition and security (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Define pipelines securely, with reviewed definitions and constrained triggers.
content_fields.guidance: Pipeline definitions should be version-controlled and code-reviewed, triggers should exclude untrusted events from privileged workflows, and any deployment step should require an approval gate.
content_fields.missing: The pipeline definitions and the branch and environment protection settings that would constrain them.
content_fields.conclusion: There is no definition in the repository to secure, and the protection settings live in the hosting platform.
content_fields.action: The CI/CD owners should author the pipeline definitions under review and configure environment approvals.
